blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Memory enables language model assistants to maintain continuity across sessions and generate personalized responses, but knowing more about a user does not necessarily produce responses they prefer. Existing evaluations assess memory capabilities without directly establishing whether memory use benefits the user. To study this gap, we collect approximately 1,000 pairwise judgments from 87 participants using their own ChatGPT queries and personal memories. We find that memory-conditioned responses are not consistently preferred over responses generated without memory and in some cases, users strongly prefer the latter. Automatic evaluators also show limited agreement with users and favor memory-conditioned responses substantially more often than users do. Motivated by these gaps, we introduce a memory-aware reward model that learns from user judgments, achieving 72.8\% preference prediction accuracy and outperforming the existing baselines. Our findings motivate evaluation and optimization objectives that align memory use with the preferences of the people whose information is being used.
blocks.zh: 内存使语言模型助理能够保持会话的连续性,生成个性化的响应,但更多了解一个用户并不一定产生他们喜欢的响应. 现有评价评估内存能力时没有直接确定内存的使用是否有利于用户. 为了研究这一差距,我们利用他们自己的ChatGPT查询和个人记忆,从87名参与者那里收集了大约1 000个双向判断。 我们发现,与无记忆反应相比,有内存条件的反应并非一贯优先,在某些情况下,用户更倾向于后者。 自动评价员也显示与用户的一致程度有限,比用户更倾向于内存条件化的回复。 基于这些差距,我们引入了一个记忆意识奖励模型,从用户判断中吸取教训,实现72.8+Q偏好预测准确性,并超越现有基线。 我们的调查结果激励着评价和优化目标,使记忆的使用与信息使用对象的偏好相一致。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Memory has emerged as a key component of conversational language models, enabling them to retain and reuse information beyond their context length and across multiple conversation sessions. Existing work has explored mechanisms for storing past experiences, managing information across context windows, and retrieving knowledge to support subsequent reasoning and action ( Zhong et al., 2023 ; Packer et al., 2023 ) . These capabilities support continuity across interactions and tasks. In persistent assistants, memory allows models to employ information about the user including their persona, their expressed preferences, and past requests to generate more personalized and contextually appropriate responses.
blocks.zh: 记忆已作为对话语言模式的一个关键组成部分出现,使其能够保留和再利用超出其上下文长度和跨越多个对话会话的信息。 现有工作探索了存储以往经验、管理跨上下文窗口信息以及获取知识以支持其后推理和行动的机制(Zhong等人,2023年;Packer等人,2023年)。 这些能力支持互动和任务的连续性。 在持久性助手中,内存允许模型使用用户的信息,包括个人信息a,他们表达的偏好,以及过去的请求,生成更个性化和适合具体情况的响应.

blocks.en: Much of the progress in long-term memory has been measured by and optimized for benchmarks like LongMemEval ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , Locomo ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) , and PersonaMem ( Jiang et al., 2025a ) that evaluate whether models can compress and recover information from past interactions to the current session. However, accurate recall and successful preference inference do not ensure appropriate memory usage. Consider a user who previously requested explanations tailored to their profession and now asks for a general overview of a topic. Reusing that preference may appear relevant and personalized, yet narrow the answer in a way the current request does not warrant. Recent studies document such failures through over-personalization and inappropriate memory use ( Hu et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026a ; Pulipaka et al., 2026 ) . These errors cannot be characterized solely as failures of memory accuracy or retrieval. They mainly concern how available information should be used for LLM response.
blocks.zh: 长期记忆中的许多进展都是通过LongMemEval(吴等人,2025年),Locomo(Maharana等人,2024年),PersonaMem(Jiang等人,2025年a)等基准来衡量和优化的,这些基准评价模型是否能够从以往的互动中压缩和回收信息,供本届会议使用. 然而,准确的召回和成功的偏好推论并不能确保适当的内存使用. 考虑一个用户,他以前要求根据自己的专业作出解释,现在要求全面概述一个专题。 重新使用这种偏好可能看起来是相关和个性化的,但以某种方式缩小答案的范围,使目前的请求没有必要。 最近的研究通过过度个性化和不适当地使用记忆来记录这种失败(Hu等人,2026年;Feng等人,2026年a;Pulipaka等人,2026年). 这些错误不能仅仅定性为内存准确性或检索失败. 它们主要涉及如何利用现有信息应对LLM。

blocks.en: To understand whether memory-based personalization produces responses that users prefer, we collect approximately 1,000 response-pair judgments from 87 participants . Participants construct personal memory profiles from their own ChatGPT interactions and recent experiences, then evaluate paired responses to queries drawn from their interaction histories. Each pair uses the same query and generator, with one response receiving retrieved memories and the other generated without them. Crucially, participants judge responses grounded in their memories, allowing us to examine the value of personalization from user’s perspective.
blocks.zh: 为了了解基于记忆的个性化是否会产生用户喜欢的反应,我们从87名参与者那里收集了大约1000个响应-pair判断. 与会者根据自己的ChatGPT互动和最近的经验构建个人记忆简介,然后评价对从互动历史中得出的询问的对应答复。 每对都使用相同的查询和生成器,一个响应接收被检索的记忆,另一个生成时没有它们. 关键是,参与者根据记忆来判断回应,使我们能够从用户的角度来审视个性化的价值。

blocks.en: Our findings reveal a gap between personalizing a response using the user’s memory and producing a response that user prefers . Memory-conditioned responses do not consistently outperform responses generated without memory, and personalization sometimes backfires as users strongly prefer the response generated without their personal context. These findings challenge the assumption that incorporating relevant personal information necessarily improves the user experience and motivate new evaluation and optimization objective for memory-augmented language models.
blocks.zh: 我们的发现显示,在利用用户的内存使反应个性化和产生用户喜欢的反应之间存在着差距。 具有内存条件的响应不能一贯地超过没有内存生成的响应,个性化有时会反射,因为用户强烈喜欢没有个人背景生成的响应. 这些调查结果对下述假设提出质疑:纳入相关的个人信息必然会改善用户的经验,并激励对内存强化语言模型的新评价和优化目标。

blocks.en: We next examine whether automatic evaluators capture these preferences. When given access to the user’s memories alongside the query and candidate responses, a direct LLM judge and pretrained reward models show limited agreement with users, with prediction accuracy close to the majority baseline. They also select memory-conditioned responses substantially more often than users do. This discrepancy identifies a second gap: automatic evaluation of memory-conditioned responses do not reliably reflect the user’s preferences .
blocks.zh: 我们接下来审查自动评估人员是否掌握了这些偏好。 在与查询和候选人答复一起访问用户记忆时,一名直接的LLM法官和预先训练的奖励模型显示与用户的一致程度有限,预测准确性接近多数基线。 他们还比用户更频繁地选择具有内存条件的响应. 这一差异查明了第二个差距:自动评价内存条件化的答复不能可靠地反映用户的偏好。

blocks.en:
To examine these gaps, we explore an initial
interpretable framework for analyzing how
memory use relates to user preferences, In
conventional reward modeling, a model learns R θ ​ ( q , y ) R_{\theta}(q,y) from human comparisons of responses to a user query q q ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) . We introduce Memory-Aware Reward Model that make user memory M M explicit in R θ ​ ( q , y , M ) R_{\theta}(q,y,M) , learning preferences over both response quality and the appropriateness of memory use. Crucially, our supervision comes from real users judging responses grounded in their own memories, providing direct evidence of when and how they want remembered information to influence an answer. Applying rubric-based reward modeling to this problem, we achieve 72.8% accuracy, compared with 59.6% for a direct zero-shot LLM judge and 58.8% mean accu-racy for pretrained rewards.

常规奖励模型,一个模型从人类对一个用户查询qq的答复的比较中学习R θ(q,y) R_{\theta}(q,y) (Oyang等人,2022年). 我们引入了内存-软件奖励模型,使用户内存MM在R θ(q,y,M) R_{\theta}(q,y,M)中明确,学习优于反应质量和使用内存的适当性. 关键是,我们的监督来自真正的用户判断基于自己记忆的反应,直接证明他们希望记忆中的信息何时以及如何影响答案。 将基于标码的奖励模型应用到这个问题上,我们实现了72.8%的准确度,而直接无镜头LLM评委的准确度为59.6%,预训奖励的精确度为58.8%。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold (1) a dataset of response preferences grounded in participants’ own queries and memories, enabling direct study of how users experience memory-based personalization. (2) identification of two evaluation gaps: personalization does not consistently yield user preferred responses, and the existing automatic evaluators do not capture users’ choices. (3) a memory-aware preference model that provides a interpretable proxy for human preference of memory usage that outperform the existing baselines. Together, these contributions establish human preference as a necessary point of reference for assessing the value of memory in personalized assistants.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三:(1) 以参与者自己的询问和记忆为基础的反应偏好数据集,能够直接研究用户如何体验基于记忆的个人化。 (2) 找出两个评价差距:个性化不能一贯地引起用户的首选反应,现有的自动评价员不能捕捉用户的选择。 (3)内存意识偏好模型,为人类对内存使用偏好提供可解释的代名词,它的表现超过了现有的基线. 这些贡献共同确立了人类的偏好,作为评估个人化助理记忆价值的必要参照点.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Long-term memory systems enable language model assistants to accumulate and reuse information beyond a single context window. Existing approaches span external retrieval ( Zhong et al., 2023 ; Packer et al., 2023 ; Chhikara et al., 2025 ) , graph-based memory stores ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) , learned policies for memory management ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) , and parametric memory ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Lei et al., 2026 ) . A growing set of benchmarks evaluates these capabilities through recall and multi-session reasoning ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Tan et al., 2025 ) , dynamic user profiling and personalized responses ( Jiang et al., 2025a ; Jiang et al., 2025b ) , and tracking evolving user or world states ( Liu et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026b ; Fan et al., 2026 ) . These evaluations primarily measure whether information can be retained, recovered, and updated, leaving less clear how an assistant should behave once relevant memories are available in context. Recent work moves beyond recall to examine whether past chat history supports downstream actions ( He et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026b ) . Our work extends this focus by analyzing user preference and learning rubric-based proxies for memory usage grounded in real human preferences.
blocks.zh: 长期内存系统使语言模型助手能够累积和再利用单个上下文窗口之外的信息. 现有方法跨越外部检索范围(Zhong等人,2023年;Packer等人,2023年;Chhikara等人,2025年),基于图表的存储库。 (徐等人著,2025年;蒋等人著,2026年),记忆管理学习政策(王等人著,2025年;颜等人著,2026年),及参数记忆(王等人著,2024年;李等人著,2026年). 越来越多的基准通过召回和多会推理评估这些能力(Maharana等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年;Tan等人,2025年),动态用户概况和个人化反应(Jiang等人,2025年a; Jiang等人,2025b),并跟踪不断发展的用户或世界状态(Liu等人,2026a; Li等人, 2026b; Fan等人, 2026 ). 这些评价主要衡量是否可以保留、恢复和更新信息,使助理在有相关记忆时表现得不太清楚。 最近的工作超越了召回,以审查过去聊天历史是否支持下游行动(He等人,2026年;Shen等人,2026年;Feng等人,2026年b). 我们的工作通过分析用户的偏好,以及基于真实人类偏好而基于学习主题的内存使用代词,扩展了这一重点.

blocks.en:
LLM personalization has traditionally represented users through profiles, personas, demographic or preference attributes, and collections of prior interactions, which are then used to condition generation or predict individual preferences ( Salemi et al., 2024 ; Kirk et al., 2024 ; Dong et al., 2024 ; Ryan et al., 2025a ) . However, incorporating personal information does not always improve a response: recent work identifies over-personalization as a failure of using user information when it can feel unnecessary, distracing, sycophantic, or even privacy-intrusive ( Hu et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026a ) . OP-Bench evaluates irrelevant personalization, repetition, and sycophancy, while PersistBench examines cross-domain memory leakage and memory-induced sycophancy ( Hu et al., 2026 ; Pulipaka et al., 2026 ) .
We instead treat appropriate memory use as a preference learning problem. Rather than assuming a fixed notion of when personalization is desirable, we collect response-level preferences from users over controlled variations of memory-conditioned responses and use these judgments to recover signals for how user memory should shape a response.
blocks.zh:
LLM个性化传统上通过剖面、人物、人口属性或偏好属性以及收集先前的相互作用来代表用户,然后用来限制产生或预测个人偏好(Salemi等人,2024年;Kirk等人,2024年;Dong等人,2024年;Ryan等人,2025年a) 。 然而,纳入个人信息并不总是能改进回应:最近的工作将过度个性化认定为在用户信息可能感到不必要的,分散的,sycophanic,甚至隐私侵入时未能使用(Hu等人,2026年;Feng等人,2026年a). 。 。 。 OP-Bench评价无关的个性化,重复,和节奏,而Persist Bench则研究跨域内存渗漏和记忆引起的节奏(Hu等人,2026年;Pulipaka等人,2026年).
相反,我们把适当的记忆使用作为一个优先学习问题。 我们不是假设何时个人化是可取的固定概念,而是收集用户对内存条件化反应的可控变数的响应级别偏好,并利用这些判断来恢复用户内存应如何塑造反应的信号.

blocks.en: Post-training aligns language models with human preferences through learned reward signals or direct preference optimization ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Bai et al., 2022 ; Rafailov et al., 2023 ) . Standard formulations assess candidate responses to a single prompt, whereas recent work extends preference modeling to multi-turn conversations and agent trajectories ( Shani et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024 ) , or conditions judgments on user-specific summaries and learned user representations ( Nam et al., 2026 ; Shenfeld et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . Beyond scaler reward model, rubric-based reward model raises for its interpretability, sample-efficiency, performance ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Ryan et al., 2025b ) . We extend preference-based alignment to cross-session memory, learning a rubric-based reward model that conditions on user memory and learns whether and how it should influnce the current response.
blocks.zh: 培训后通过学习奖励信号或直接优化偏好,使语言模式与人类偏好保持一致(Oyang等人,2022年;Bai等人,2022年;Rafailov等人,2023年)。 标准配方评估候选人对单一即时反应的反应,而最近的工作则将偏好模式扩大到多回合对话和代理轨迹(Shani等人,2024年;Shi等人,2024年),或对用户特定摘要和学习过的用户表述作出有条件的判断(Nam等人,2026年;Shenfeld等人,2025年;Li等人,2024年)。 在规模奖励模式之外,基于卢标的奖励模式提高了其解释性、样本效率、性能(Gunjal等人,2026年;Liu等人,2025年b;Liu等人,2026年b;Ryan等人,2025年b)。 我们把基于偏爱的对齐推广到跨会话内存,学习一个基于数字的奖励模式,该模式以用户内存为条件,并学习它是否以及如何影响当前的反应.

blocks.en: 3 Data Collection
blocks.zh: 3个 数据收集

blocks.en: We recruit participants from Prolific for a roughly 30-minute annotation task, paid at 14 USD per hour, and collect approximately 1,000 response-pair judgments (1,047 in total: 972 preference judgments and 75 test–retest repeats). We exclude the repeats from training and evaluation and filter the annotations for quality, leaving 821 judgments from 87 participants , of which 673 are strict preferences and 148 are ties. Each judgment records an annotator’s preference between two responses to the same query in the context of their personal memories. Evaluation separates participants across training, validation, and test within each split (Section 5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们从普罗利菲克招募参与者从事大约30分钟的注解工作,每小时支付14美元,并收集了大约1,000份答复-答复-答复判决(共1,047份:972份优先判决和75份测试-重复判决)。 我们把重复排除在培训和评价之外,并过滤说明的质量,留下87名参与者的821项判决,其中673项是严格偏好,148项是联系。 每项判决都记录了一名书记员倾向于根据个人记忆对同一问题作出两个答复。 评价将参与者分为培训、鉴定和每分部分的测试(第5节)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Personal Context Collection
blocks.zh: 3.1 个人资料收藏

blocks.en: Participants accessed the study through Prolific and constructed an editable memory profile by running an extraction prompt in their own ChatGPT account. The prompt draws on previous ChatGPT sessions and existing memories to (1) produce user profile such as age, occupation, location, etc. (2) infer user preferences around 10 topics including entertainment, lifestyle, communication, etc. (3) extract 100 their recent queries, excluding those dependent on unavailable attachments or prior context. Participants then entered specific events from the preceding month through typing or editable voice transcription, with a target of 30 events.
blocks.zh: 参与者通过Prolific访问该研究,并通过在自己的ChatGPT账户中运行一个提取提示来构建一个可编辑的内存配置. 提示引用了之前的ChatGPT会话和现有的记忆 (1) 生成用户简介,如年龄,职业,位置等. (2)推断用户偏好围绕娱乐,生活方式,交流等10个话题. (3) 摘录其最近的100项查询,但不包括那些取决于未提供附件或先前上下文的查询。 然后,与会者通过打字或编辑语音记录输入前一个月的具体活动,目标是30项活动。

blocks.en: Note that we carefully avoid uploading any personal data to our servers: full conversation histories and attachments were not uploaded and we explicitly instruct the model and participants to avoid including sensitive information. Appendix E.1 reproduces the complete prompt, and Figures 2 – 3 show the collection interfaces. PII removal and de-identification procedures are described in Appendix A.4 .
blocks.zh: 请注意,我们小心避免将任何个人数据上传到我们的服务器:完整的对话历史和附件没有上传,我们明确指示模型和参与者避免包括敏感信息。 附录E.1转载了完整的快捷键,图2 – 3显示了收藏界面. 附录A.4说明了PII的清除和去除识别程序。

blocks.en: 3.2 Response Pair Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 建造反应对等系统

blocks.en: For each participant, we construct a candidate pool of 100 recent queries. For each query q q , we retrieve a context M q M_{q} consisting of nine memory entries using text-embedding-3-small and randomly select a response generator from GPT-5.2, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and Claude-Opus-5. The selected model generates two responses in separate calls: one conditioned on the retrieved context M q M_{q} and one without memory. The two responses thus share the same query and generator but differ in access to personal context.
blocks.zh: 我们为每位与会者构建了100个最近查询的候选人库。 对于每个查询 q q,我们检索到一个上下文 M q M q q q } 由9个内存条目组成,使用文本嵌入-3-小,并随机选择一个响应生成器从GPT-5.2,双子座3.1-Pro,和克劳德-Opus-5中选择. 所选模型在单独的调用中生成两个响应:一个以检索到的上下文Mq MQQq}为条件,一个没有内存. 因此,两个答复的查询和生成方式相同,但在个人情况访问方面有所不同。

blocks.en: For memory-conditioned responses, we vary the instructions governing memory use across three prompting regimes: conservative , ordinary , and aggressive . The ordinary prompt instructs the model to incorporate memories where relevant and appropriate. The conservative prompt imposes a stricter criterion, instructing the model to use memories only when they would meaningfully improve the answer to the current query. The aggressive prompt encourages proactive incorporation of personal context whenever possible. Appendix E.2 provides the complete prompt templates.
blocks.zh: 对于有内存条件的响应,我们改变关于内存使用的指示,这些指示涉及三个激励机制:保守、普通和侵略。 普通的即时指示模型在相关和适当时纳入记忆. 保守的及时性规定了更严格的标准,指示模型只有在能够有意义地改进当前查询的答案时才能使用记忆. 积极性鼓励在可能时主动纳入个人背景。 附录E.2提供了完整的即时模板。

blocks.en: We also screen the 100 candidate pairs to select 15 that have substantial, memory-grounded differences in responses for human annotation. An LLM evaluator receives each query, its retrieved memories, response without memory, response with memory (using ordinary prompt) and assesses the magnitude of their substantive differences, the extent to which memory supports those differences, and the presence of unsupported changes. We rank pairs by prioritizing substantial, memory-grounded differences and retain the 15 highest-ranked pairs.
blocks.zh: 我们还筛选了100对候选夫妇,以选择15对在对人类注释的反应方面有实质性的、基于记忆的差别。 一个LLM评价员接收每个查询,其检索的记忆,没有内存的响应,用内存的响应(使用普通的即时),并评估其实质性差异的大小,内存支持这些差异的程度,以及是否存在不支持的更改. 我们通过优先排列实质性的,基于内存的差别来排列对数,并保留15个排名最高的对数.

blocks.en: 3.3 Response Preference Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.3 反应优先说明

blocks.en: Participants viewed the query and Response A and Response B side by side. They then select the answer they would prefer to receive on a five-point scale: A much better, A slightly better, about the same, B slightly better, or B much better. Optional notes allowed them to explain their choice. Instructions emphasized overall preference without prescribing greater personalization as desirable (Appendix A.3 ). Appendix B presents two complete examples with contrasting preferences.

blocks.en: 3.4 Annotator Consistency
blocks.zh: 3.4 一致性

blocks.en: Ten participants returned three days later to repeat judgments for identical queries and stored response pairs, with prior choices hidden. We measure directional agreement: whether the same response is preferred in both sessions, regardless of changes in preference strength. Overall agreement was 68.0% across 75 comparisons. Initially much preferences were more consistent than slightly preferences (73.9% versus 58.6%; Table 1 ). Due to the low consistency of the slightly better subset , we only use the much better subset that contains more consistent and clear preference signal for testing models in 6 .

blocks.en: Feature initialization. Preference annotations are used to induce candidate evaluation criteria. Each induction pass receives ten preference-labeled quadruplets from training set: the query, the retrieved memory set, both candidate responses, and which response the annotator chose. Then LLM then generates ten rubric dimensions that explain the difference between the two responses, such as response quality, formatting, or memory usage, etc. We run five independent passes, yielding roughly fifty raw proposals, many of which describe the same property in different words. A separate consolidation pass merges near-duplicates into a canonical rubric and labels each dimension memory-dependent if scoring it requires the memory contents, and memory-agnostic otherwise. blocks.en: 6 Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 6 结果和分析

blocks.en: 6.1 User Preferences for Memory Use
blocks.zh: 6.1 内存使用用户首选项

blocks.en:
We first examine whether access to personal memories produces responses that users prefer.
Table 2 summarizes memory versus no-memory comparisons across prompting regimes and response generators.
blocks.zh:
我们首先审查获得个人记忆是否会产生用户喜欢的反应。
表2汇总了各提示系统和反应发生器之间的内存与无记忆比较。

blocks.en: Table 2: Annotator preferences by prompting regime and response generator. Percentages include ties. Generator comparisons are restricted to ordinary prompting to hold the personalization instructions constant.
blocks.zh: 表2:通过提示系统和响应生成器实现的注释者偏好. 百分比包括联系。 发电机比较仅限于普通的提示,以保持个性化指示不变.

blocks.en:
Under ordinary prompting, annotators prefer the memory-conditioned response in 38.7% of comparisons and the response generated without memory in 41.9%, with the remaining comparisons judged about the same.
Thus, supplying personal context does not yield a clear advantage in this setting.
These results directly illustrate the distinction motivating our study: knowing more about a user does not necessarily produce an answer they prefer.
blocks.zh:
在一般的提示下,注释者更喜欢38.7%的比较中以内存为条件的响应,41.9%的比较中生成的没有内存的响应,其余的比较则判断相同.
因此,提供个人背景在此情况下并不产生明显的好处。
这些结果直接说明了促使我们进行研究的区别:更多地了解一个用户并不一定产生他们喜欢的答案。

blocks.en:
Across conservative, ordinary, and aggressive prompting (Appendix E.2 ), preference for memory-conditioned responses decreases from 43.3% to 38.7% and 34.6%, respectively.
Under aggressive prompting, users prefer the no-memory response in 49.3% of comparisons.
Encouraging more personalization therefore does not necessarily improve the user experience.
Even conservative prompting produces only a small descriptive advantage over responses without memory, suggesting that appropriate memory use requires more than a general instruction to personalize selectively.
This pattern is consistent with concerns about over-personalization raised in recent work Hu et al. (2026) ; Feng et al. (2026a) .
blocks.zh:
在保守、普通和积极促动方面(附录E.2),对内存条件反应的偏好分别从43.3%降至38.7%和34.6%。
在激烈的提示下,用户在49.3%的比较中倾向于无记忆反应.
因此,鼓励更个性化并不一定改善用户的经验。
即使是保守的提示,也只产生比没有记忆的响应小的描述优势,说明适当的记忆使用需要比一般的指令更需要有选择的个性化.
这一模式与近期著作Hu等人(2026年);Feng等人(2026年a年)提出的过度个性化关切是一致的。

blocks.en:
Under ordinary prompting, memory-conditioned responses are preferred more often than no-memory responses for GPT and Claude, whereas the pattern reverses for Gemini (Table 2 ).
The aggregate result therefore conceals differences in the direction of preference.
Rather than showing that memory is uniformly unhelpful, these findings suggest that its value depends on how the generator incorporates personal context into its answer.
blocks.zh:
在普通的提示下,对GPT和Claude来说,比无记忆反应更倾向于有内存条件的反应,而对双子座来说,模式则相反(表2 )。
因此,总结果掩盖了优惠方向的差异。
这些结论不是表明记忆是无益的,而是表明其价值取决于生成者如何将个人背景纳入其答案。

blocks.en:
These results concern the screened comparisons described in Section 3.2, which prioritize substantial, memory-grounded response differences.
Within this setting, they establish our first evaluation gap: memory-based personalization does not consistently translate into user-preferred responses.
blocks.zh:
这些结果涉及第3.2节所述的经过筛选的比较,该节将重大、基于内存的反应差异列为优先事项。
在这个背景下,它们确立了我们的第一个评价差距:基于内存的个人化不能一致地转化为用户偏爱的反应。

blocks.en: 6.2 Automatic Evaluators Failed to Capture User Preferences
blocks.zh: 6.2 捕获用户首选项的自动评估失败

blocks.en: Table 3: Preference prediction accuracy. Majority is calculated by always choosing without memory. Skywork is the Reward-V2 Llama-3.1-8B checkpoint, scoring each response independently and then compare the score. We include two variants of Skywork: query only (no memory) and query with the retrieved memories. For both LLM Judge and Skywork, we varied several different prompts/formats and the results listed is the best performance.
blocks.zh: 表3:优先预测准确性。 多数通过总是在没有记忆的情况下选择来计算. Skywork是Reward-V2 Llama-3.1-8B检查点,每个响应都独立得分,然后比较得分. 我们包含了Skywork的两个变体:只查询(没有内存)和与检索的内存查询. 对于LLM Judge和Skywork来说,我们有几种不同的提示/格式,列出的结果是最好的表现。

blocks.en:
Direct GPT-5.2 judging achieves 58.1% accuracy in the single-order evaluation (Table 3 ), with a similar result when combining both presentation orders through confidence-weighted voting (57.9%).
Pretrained Skywork-Reward-V2 achieves 52.9% with the participant’s memories in context.
Both perform close to, or below, the 55.0% majority baseline.
Even on comparisons with strong expressed preferences, access to the query, memories, and responses is therefore insufficient for these evaluators to reliably recover the user’s choice.
blocks.zh:
直接 GBT-5.2 判断成绩 58.1%的单一顺序评价准确性(表3),在通过信心加权表决将两种列报顺序合并时,结果类似(57.9%)。
预训的Skywork-Reward-V2 实现 52.9%与参与者的记忆有关。
两者的业绩接近或低于55.0%的多数基线。
因此,即使与强烈表达的偏好进行比较,查阅查询、记忆和答复也不足以使这些评价人员可靠地恢复用户的选择。

blocks.en:
The direct judge under two-order voting and Skywork select memory-conditioned responses in 67.2% and 81.1% of comparisons, respectively, compared with 45.0% for annotators.
Removing memories from Skywork’s input reverses this tendency but leaves accuracy close to the majority baseline.
Its choices are therefore strongly affected by the availability of personal context, without closely matching user preferences in either configuration.
These results highlight the gap between rewarding personalization and assessing its value to the user.
blocks.zh:
两序投票制和Skywork制下的直接裁判分别以67.2%和81.1%的比较率选择了内存有条件的回答,而注释员则以45.0%的比例选择.
从Skywork的输入中移除记忆会扭转这一趋势,但精度会接近大多数基线.
因此,其选择受到个人环境的可用性的巨大影响,在两种配置中都没有紧密匹配用户偏好.
这些结果凸显出奖励个性化与评估其对用户的价值之间的差距.

blocks.en:
We next provide the LLM judge with the rubric criteria extracted following Section 4.2 , emphasizing task-relevant memory use, appropriate non-use, and avoidance of unsupported personal assumptions.
This rubric judge achieves 59.6% accuracy in the single-order evaluation, compared with 58.1% for direct judging on the same comparisons (Table 3 ).
Making these considerations explicit offers a modest improvement, but leaves substantial disagreement with users.
The evaluator must still determine how to weigh competing criteria, motivating our approach of learning their aggregation directly from user judgments.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来向LLM法官提供第4.2节之后摘录的标点标准,强调与任务相关的内存使用,适当的不使用,以及避免不支持的个人假设.
这名法官实现了 单级评价的准确度为59.6%,而直接根据同一比较判断的为58.1%(表3)。
明确这些考虑可以略有改进,但与用户有很大的分歧。
评价人员仍必须确定如何权衡相互竞争的标准,促使我们直接从用户判断中学习其汇总方法。

blocks.en: 6.3 Learning to Predict Response Preferences
blocks.zh: 6.3 学习预测反应优惠

blocks.en: Our model achieves 72.8% accuracy, outperforming the majority baseline (55.0%), direct LLM judging (58.1%), and rubric-based LLM judging (59.6%; Table 3 ), approaching the test-retest consistency of 73.9%. This improvement is observed across all three response generators, with accuracies of 66.0%, 75.0%, and 82.2% on GPT, Gemini, and Claude generated pairs, respectively. For each of these models, our method exceed the baselines significantly, highlighting the effectiveness of learning to aggregate multiple rubric dimensions from human preferences, rather than relying on an LLM judge to implicitly weigh these criteria through prompting alone.
blocks.zh: 我们的模型精度达到72.8%,超过了大多数基线(55.0%),直接的LLM判断(58.1%),基于数字的LLM判断(59.6%;表3),接近73.9%的测试-测试一致性。 在所有三个响应发电机中都观察到这种改进,在GPT、双子座和Claude生成的对子上分别为66.0%、75.0%和82.2%。 对于每个模型,我们的方法都大大超过基线,突出了从人类偏好中学习集合多个数字维度的效果,而不是依靠LLM判断员通过单独提示来暗中权衡这些标准.

blocks.en: Table 4 lists the five most influential features in a descriptive fit of our model. The two largest coefficients are presentational: the memory-conditioned response is more likely to be preferred when it has more headings ( + 0.646 +0.646 ) and is relatively longer ( + 0.571 +0.571 ). This is consistent with ( Dubois et al., 2024 ; Singhal et al., 2023 ) which shows that human have a strong preference for longer responses and it’s hard to distangle quality from length, where in our case, we are also need to distangle length and memory usage.
blocks.zh: 表4列出了我们模式中最具影响力的五个特征。 两个最大的系数是陈述性:当内存条件反应有更多标题(+ 0.646 + 0.646 ) , 并且相对较长(+ 0.571 + 0.571 ) 时,它更容易被偏好。 这与(Dubois等人,2024年;Singhal等人,2023年)一致,它表明人类对更长的反应有强烈的偏好,而且很难将质量从长度中分解出来,而就我们而言,我们需要将长度和内存使用分开。

blocks.en: Memory-related features are also important by taking three out of top five influential features. Memory relevance and assumption proportionality have coefficient + 0.386 +0.386 and + 0.323 +0.323 , respectively, and unwarranted personal assumptions, ranked fifth, has a negative coefficient of − 0.201 -0.201 . This shows that annotator prefers response when the personal context is relevant and the resulting inferences are justified, rather than unwanted assumptions of user beyond query indicates.
blocks.zh: 记忆相关特征也很重要,通过将前五个有影响力的特征中的三个取而代之. 内存相关性和假设比例分别有系数+0.386+0.386和+0.323+0.323,无端的个人假设排名第五,负系数为−0.201-0.201. 这表明,当个人背景相关且由此产生的推论合理时,注释者更倾向于回应,而不是询问后用户的不想要的假设.

blocks.en: Following the ablation described in 5 , we divide the features into two blocks: memory-related features and response-related features. The memory-only and response-only models achieve 62.5% and 67.0% pooled accuracy, respectively, while combining both feature groups increases accuracy to 72.8%, outperforming the two ablations by 10.3 and 5.8 percentage points. Importantly, all variants use the same evaluator inputs and feature scores, differing only in the features retained for regression. The improvement over the response-only model therefore demonstrates that memory-related criteria provide additional predictive information beyond general response attributes. This pattern is consistent across all three response generators, with the full model achieving the highest accuracy in each case. Together, these results suggest that capturing user preferences for memory-conditioned responses requires considering both the appropriateness of memory use and the overall quality of the response.
blocks.zh: 在5中描述的衰竭后,我们将这些特征分为两个块:内存相关特征和响应相关特征. 仅内存和只反应的模型分别达到62.5%和67.0%的集合精度,同时结合两个特征组的精度提高到72.8%,比两个集合的精度高出10.3和5.8个百分点. 重要的是,所有变体都使用相同的评价投入和特征分数,仅在为回归而保留的特征方面有所不同。 因此,对只反应模型的改进表明,与内存有关的标准提供了超出一般反应属性的额外预测信息。 在所有三个反应发电机中,这种模式是一致的,完整的模型在每种情况下都达到最高的准确度。 这些结果表明,要抓住用户对内存条件化反应的偏好,既需要考虑内存使用是否适当,也需要考虑反应的整体质量。

blocks.zh: 表4:在我们模型的描述性与291对明确偏好相适应时,具有最大标准化系数的五个特征。 正系数有利于内存条件响应; Mem. 标记内存相关特性.

blocks.en: Ranking comparisons by | p ^ − 0.5 | |\hat{p}-0.5| raises our model’s accuracy from 72.8% at full coverage to 76.2% at 75% coverage, 83.7% at 50% coverage, and 88.8% at 25% coverage (Table 5 ). Retaining the highest-confidence quarter increases accuracy by 16.0 points. The model’s confidence therefore helps identify comparisons whose annotator preferences it predicts more accurately, supporting selective use of its predictions when coverage can be traded for accuracy. This selective prediction shows the reliability of the learned aggregation model, and also can provide more accuate signal if used to evaluate the model responses or used as reward model to train LLM.
blocks.zh: 将我们的模型精度从72.8%的全覆盖提高到76.2%的75%,83.7%的覆盖率提高到50%,88.8%的覆盖率提高到25%(表5)。 保留最高自信季度的精度提高16.0分. 因此,该模型的信心有助于确定比较,它能更准确地预测其注释者偏好,支持有选择地使用其预测值,以换取准确性。 这种选择性的预测显示了所学聚合模型的可靠性,如果用来评价模型的响应,或者用作训练LLM的奖励模型,也可以提供更精密的信号.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We investigated how users want personal memories to shape assistant responses, using judgments from 87 participants evaluating answers to their own queries with their own memories. In our screened comparisons, memory-conditioned responses were not consistently preferred, and more aggressive personalization received less favorable judgments. Existing automatic evaluators favored memory-conditioned responses more often than users did, highlighting a mismatch between rewarding personalization and capturing its value to the user.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了用户希望个人记忆如何塑造助理反应,利用87名参与者的判断,用自己的记忆来评价自己询问的答案. 在经过筛选的比较中,没有一贯地倾向于以内存为条件的反应,更积极的个性化得到了不太有利的判断。 与用户相比,现有自动评估人员更经常地倾向于内存条件化的回复,这突出表明了奖励个性化和为用户获取其价值之间的不匹配。

blocks.en: To address this gap, we introduced a memory-aware reward model that learns to aggregate interpretable rubric features from user preferences. The model achieved 72.8% accuracy on clear-preference comparisons with held-out participants, outperforming direct LLM judging and pretrained reward baselines. Combining memory-related criteria with general response attributes improved prediction over either feature group alone, indicating that evaluating memory use requires considering both its appropriateness and the quality of the resulting answer. These findings establish user-grounded preference learning as a promising direction for evaluating memory-augmented assistants. Extending this supervision to post-training remains an important next step toward assistants that learn when and how remembered information improves the response a user wants to receive.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了一个内存意识奖励模式,学习从用户偏好中汇总可解释的标点特征. 该模型在与被搁置的参与者进行明确优惠比较时实现了72.8%的准确度,优于直接的LLM判断和预先训练的奖励基线. 将与内存有关的标准与一般反应属性结合起来,仅能改善对任一特征组的预测,表明评价内存使用情况既需要考虑其适当性,也需要考虑由此产生的答案的质量。 这些调查结果将基于用户的偏好学习确定为评价内存辅助人员的一个有希望的方向。 将这种监督扩大到培训后,仍然是向助理人员迈出的重要一步,这些助理要了解记忆中的信息何时以及如何改善用户希望得到的反应。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our study has several limitations. First, our dataset captures user context through memory profiles constructed from participants’ own ChatGPT interactions and recent events they entered. While this approach grounds preference judgments in authentic personal experiences, it covers a particular form of user memory. Persistent assistants may encounter more diverse information distributed across conversations, documents, applications, and everyday activities. Extending our findings to these settings will require richer, multi-source, longitudinal collection of user context, together with preferences grounded in that context.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究有几个局限性。 首先,我们的数据集通过参与者自己的 ChatGPT 交互和他们输入的最近事件构建的内存配置来捕捉用户背景. 虽然这种方法在真实的个人经历中作为判断偏好的理由,但它涵盖了一种特定的用户记忆形式. 长期助理可能会遇到在对话、文件、应用程序和日常活动中传播的更加多样化的信息。 将我们的调查结果扩展至这些环境,将需要更丰富、多来源、纵向的用户背景汇编,以及基于这一背景的偏好。

blocks.en: Second, our data and rubrics focus on single-turn conversational responses with retrieved memories supplied as context. In multi-turn conversations and agentic tasks, appropriate memory use may depend on the interaction trajectory, the actions an assistant takes, and changes in the user’s goals or circumstances. Memory acquisition, updating, and deletion may also shape users’ expectations of subsequent behavior. Our test–retest study provides an initial assessment of preference consistency, but does not capture longer-term dynamics. Extending the framework will require trajectory-level judgments and evaluation criteria that account for both evolving user preferences and the consequences of memory use across interactions.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们的数据和标题侧重于单回合对话反应,作为上下文提供检索的记忆。 在多回合对话和代理任务中,适当的内存使用可能取决于交互轨迹,助手采取的行动,以及用户目标或环境的变化. 内存的获取,更新和删除也可能塑造用户对后续行为的预期. 我们的测试 - 测试研究提供了对优惠一致性的初步评估,但并没有捕捉长期动态。 扩大框架需要轨迹一级的判断和评价标准,这些标准既考虑到用户不断演变的偏好,又考虑到在互动过程中使用内存的后果。

blocks.en: Finally, our experiments evaluate memory-aware preference modeling in an offline setting. An important next step is to use this supervision in assistant post-training and assess whether improvements in preference prediction translate into better memory-use behavior and user experience. This would establish how the learned criteria transfer from evaluating candidate responses and predicting user preference to guiding generation.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们的实验 评估记忆意识偏好模型 在离线设置。 下一步的一个重要步骤是利用这种监督进行后培训助理,并评估优惠预测方面的改进是否转化为更好的内存使用行为和用户经验。 这将确定所学标准如何从评价候选人答复和预测用户偏好转向指导生成。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Our study involves human participants and personal information derived from their interactions with an AI assistant. The study was approved by an institutional research ethics committee. Participants were recruited through Prolific for a 30-minute task, compensated at USD 14 per hour, and provided informed consent before data collection. Participants could edit their memory profiles before submission and both the AI assistant and the participant were instructed to exclude sensitive information and direct identifiers. Full conversation histories and attachments were not uploaded to the study platform. Appendix A.4 describes our de-identification protocol for data release, including consistent replacement of identifiers, generalization of identifying details, and contextual review across each participant’s records.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究涉及人类参与者和从他们与AI助手的互动中获得的个人信息. 这项研究得到了机构研究伦理委员会的核准。 与会者通过Prolific招聘,承担30分钟的任务,每小时14美元补偿,并在收集数据之前获得知情同意。 与会者可在提交之前编辑其记忆简介,并指示AI助理和参与者排除敏感信息和直接识别资料。 完整的对话历史和附件没有上传到研究平台。 附录A.4描述了我们的数据公布的去识别协议,包括连贯一致地替换识别符,概括识别细节,以及在每个参与者的记录中进行背景审查。

blocks.en: Our work aims to help assistants use personal memories in ways that better reflect users’ preferences. However, predicted preference should not be interpreted as consent to collect, retain, or disclose personal information. Moreover, preferences learned across participants may not reflect an individual user’s expectations. Applications of the proposed approach should preserve explicit user control over memory and respect privacy constraints independently.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作旨在帮助助手使用个人记忆的方式更好地反映用户的喜好. 然而,预期的偏好不应被解释为同意收集、保留或披露个人信息。 此外,参与者之间学到的偏好可能不能反映个人用户的期望。 拟议办法的应用应保持用户对内存的明确控制,并独立尊重隐私限制。

blocks.en: A.4 PII Removal and De-identification Protocol
blocks.zh: A.4 PII 清除和消除身份识别议定书

blocks.en: Personal memories can identify their owners through explicit identifiers or combinations of otherwise ordinary details. Our de-identification protocol therefore covers both direct identifiers and contextual disclosure, while preserving the information needed to interpret response preferences. Its scope includes profiles, event memories, queries, candidate responses, free-text annotations, and accompanying metadata.
blocks.zh: 个人记忆可以通过明确的识别码或组合其他普通细节来识别其拥有者. 因此,我们的去识别协议既包括直接识别特征,也包括背景披露,同时保留解释反应偏好所需的信息。 其范围包括简介、事件记忆、查询、候选答复、自由文本说明以及随附的元数据。

blocks.en: The persona extraction prompt explicitly prohibits real names, email addresses, telephone numbers, exact home addresses, specific company and school names, social accounts, and identification numbers. It instructs the extractor to replace such details with abstract descriptions, such as “a tech company” or “a well-known university,” and applies the same restriction to profile tags. The query-extraction instructions also exclude sessions whose initial query contains substantial PII or unsafe sensitive information. These instructions reduce disclosure at collection; prompt compliance alone is not a guarantee of de-identification.
blocks.zh: 个人提取提示明确禁止真实姓名、电子邮件地址、电话号码、确切的家庭地址、具体公司和学校名称、社会账户和身份号码。 它指示提取器用抽象描述来取代这些细节,如“技术公司”或“知名大学”,并对配置标签适用同样的限制。 查询-提取指令也排除了初始查询包含大量PII或不安全敏感信息的会话. 这些指示减少了收集时的披露;仅仅迅速遵守并不能保证去除身份。

blocks.en: The release protocol requires direct identifiers to be removed or replaced with typed placeholders, such as [PERSON_1] , [ORGANIZATION_1] , and [LOCATION_1] . Replacements must remain consistent within a participant’s records, including across a memory, its query, and both candidate responses. Exact dates, fine-grained locations, and distinctive employment or biographical details require generalization when their combination could identify a person. The same rules cover third parties mentioned in memories. Recruitment identifiers, contact details, and operational metadata are excluded from released records; random study identifiers preserve participant grouping without exposing recruitment identifiers or linkage keys.
blocks.zh: 发行协议要求直接标识符被删除或替换为打入的占位符,例如[个人_1],[ORGANINGION化_1],以及[LOCATION_1]. 替换必须在参与人的记录中保持一致,包括在记忆、查询和候选答复中。 确切的日期、精细的工作地点以及独特的工作或履历细节,在组合起来可以识别一个人时,需要概括。 同样的规则涵盖记忆中提到的第三方。 征聘识别符、联系方式和业务元数据被排除在已公布的记录之外;随机研究识别符保留参与者分组,而不披露征聘识别符或链接密钥。

blocks.en: Release review combines automated screening for identifier patterns and named entities with contextual human inspection of complete records. The review must consider combinations of details across a participant’s memories, rather than assessing each field in isolation. Redaction must preserve task-relevant constraints, entity relationships, and the contrast between candidate responses. If removing identifying or sensitive information changes the basis of a preference, the comparison is withheld rather than retaining its label for a materially altered example. Release documentation records the affected fields and exclusions without reproducing removed identifiers. De-identification reduces disclosure risk but does not establish that personal narratives are anonymous.
blocks.zh: 发行审查将识别特征模式的自动筛选和被命名的实体与人类对完整记录的背景检查结合起来。 审查必须考虑参与者记忆中的细节组合,而不是孤立地评估每个领域。 调整行动必须保持与任务有关的制约因素、实体关系以及候选人答复之间的对比。 如果删除识别信息或敏感信息会改变偏好的基础,则不作比较,而不是保留其标签,用于重大改变的例子。 释放文件记录受影响的领域和排除情况,而不复制已删除的识别资料。 取消身份可以减少披露风险,但不能确定个人叙述是匿名的。

blocks.en: Appendix D Zero-Shot Evaluator Baselines
blocks.zh: 附录D 零点评估员

blocks.en: D.1 Direct LLM Judging
blocks.zh: D.1 直接LLM 判断

blocks.en: GPT-5.2 receives the query, retrieved memories, and both candidate responses and is asked to predict which response the user would prefer. The direct prompt supplies no rubric or explicit instructions to counter preferences for length or personalization. Calls use low reasoning effort and JSON output containing the preferred response and a rationale; a confidence variant additionally requests a score from 1 to 100. Both A/B orders were scored with confidence on the 291 clear-preference pairs shared with the regression analysis (582 calls, no failures); results are in Table 7 .
blocks.zh: GPT-5.2接收了询问,检索了记忆,以及两个候选回复,并被要求预测用户会更喜欢的响应. 直接的即时电源不提供标点指示或明确指示,以对抗对长度或个性化的偏好。 呼叫使用低推理努力和JSON输出,包含首选响应和理由;一个信任变体额外要求得分从1到100. 两个A/B订单都对回归分析共享的291个清晰的对对(582个呼叫,无故障)充满信心地得分;结果见表7。

blocks.en: We report the confidence-weighted vote of both orders after mapping predictions to the same response identities, and the subset on which both orders select the same response. The last condition changes the evaluation set and therefore uses its own majority rate. Generator-specific results refer to the model that produced the candidate responses; the judge is GPT-5.2 throughout.
blocks.zh: 我们报告两种命令在将预测映射到相同反应特性之后的置信加权表决,以及两种命令选择相同反应的子集. 最后一项条件改变了评价的设定,因此采用了自己的多数比率。 发电机特定结果指产生候选人答复的模式;法官是整个GPT-5.2。

blocks.en: Table 7: Zero-shot direct GPT-5.2 judging on the clear-preference evaluation stratum. Majority rates are computed separately for each evaluation subset.
blocks.zh: 表7:根据明确的评价层进行零镜头直接GPT-5.2判断. 每个评价子集的多数比率分别计算。

blocks.en: Predictions agree across A/B orders on 77.7% of pairs overall. Under voting, the judge’s rate of choosing the memory-conditioned response exceeds the annotators’ rate by 22.2 percentage points overall (67.2% versus 45.0%). Self-reported confidence averages 76.6 for correct judgments and 73.8 for incorrect judgments. Its correlation with correctness is .180, and with selecting the memory-conditioned response it is .064. Together, these diagnostics show that stable presentation-order choices and high self-reported confidence can coexist with disagreement with annotators.
blocks.zh: 整个A/B订单的预测一致,总共为77.7%。 在投票中,法官选择带有内存条件的回复的比率总体上超过了注释员的22.2个百分点(67.2%对45.0%)。 自我报告的信任度平均为正确判决76.6,错误判决73.8。 它与正确性的相关性为.180,在选择内存条件反应时为.064. 这些诊断表明,稳定的呈报顺序选择和高度的自报信心可以与注释者的不同意见共存。

blocks.en: The rubric judge uses a zero-shot GPT-5.2 prompt that requests a holistic preference verdict and its magnitude, explicitly discouraging preferences based solely on greater length or more personal references and favoring appropriate non-use over forced memory use. Both A/B orders were scored for all 291 pooled clear-preference comparisons (582 calls, no failures). Its reported magnitude serves as the confidence weight when the two orders are combined; verdicts of “tie” receive half credit, and the judge returned no ties on this pool.
blocks.zh: 标题判官使用零镜头的GPT-5.2提示符,该提示符请求一个整体的偏好判断及其规模,明确劝阻完全基于更长的长度或更多个人参考的偏好,并赞成适当的不使用而不是强制使用内存. 所有291个集合式明确优惠比较(582个电话,无故障)的A/B订单均得分. 据报道,在将两项命令合并时,其规模是信任的重担;“tie”的判决得到一半的赞扬,法官在这个集合中没有任何联系。

blocks.en: D.2 Pretrained Skywork Rewards
blocks.zh: D.2 预先训练的天空工程奖励

blocks.en: We use the published Skywork-Reward-V2 checkpoints as fixed reward functions. The reported row uses the Llama-3.1-8B checkpoint; the evaluation archive also includes the Qwen3 0.6B, 1.7B and 4B variants. For each candidate, the user turn contains the query and retrieved memories under [User Query] and [Relevant Memories] , and the assistant turn contains the response. The tokenizer’s chat template formats these turns, and the sequence-classification head produces a scalar reward. Both candidates receive the same query and memory context; the higher-scoring candidate is selected. No task-specific parameter updates are applied to these baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们使用公布的Skywork-Reward-V2检查站作为固定的奖励功能. 报道的行使用Llama-3.1-8B检查站;评价档案还包括Qune3 0.6B,1.7B和4B变体. 对于每个候选人,用户转动在[User Query]和[相关回忆]下包含查询和检索的记忆,助理转动包含响应. 标致器的聊天模板格式是这些转折,序列分类头则产生悬赏. 两位候选人都得到相同的查询和内存背景;评分较高的候选人被选中. 这些基线没有应用特定任务参数更新。

blocks.en: The rows in Table 3 are single zero-shot evaluations of the Llama-3.1-8B checkpoint on the 291 pooled clear-preference comparisons. With the participant’s own retrieved memories in the context it reaches 52.9% against a 55.0% majority baseline, and 63.6%, 37.5% and 73.3% on GPT-, Gemini- and Claude-generated pairs; it selects the memory-conditioned response in 81.1% of comparisons where annotators select it in 45.0%. With the memories removed from its input it reaches 58.8% (55.5%, 66.9% and 42.2% by generator) and selects the memory-conditioned response in only 19.6% of comparisons, so the preference for the memory-conditioned response is induced by the memory context rather than by the responses alone.
blocks.zh: 表3中的各行是就291个集合式明确优惠比较对Llama-3.1-8B检查站进行的单一零镜头评价。 随着参与者自己在背景中检索到的记忆达到52.9%,而多数基准为55.0%,在GPT、双子座和克劳德生成的对子上则达到63.6%、37.5%和73.3%;在81.1%的比较中选择了内存条件反应,而注释者则选择45.0%。 随着从输入中移除的记忆达到58.8%(55.5%,66.9%和42.2%),并且仅在19.6%的比较中选择了内存条件化的响应,所以对内存条件化的响应的偏好是由内存上下文引发的,而不是仅由响应引起的.
